ns2:course.label: Honors Seminar I
ns2:course.description: Themes, movements, and forms in British, American, and Anglophone literature. May be repeated. Prerequisite: A 3.33 grade-point average or consent of the English Department's Director of Undergraduate Studies. Restricted to English and Rhetoric majors.
